description.value: You have spent enough time in the deepest, darkest waters of Czelle that your vision can penetrate anything. You gain greater darkvision, enabling you to see through magical darkness even if it normally hampers darkvision. You automatically succeed at the @Check[flat|dc:5] to target a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] creature if that creature is concealed only by ink, mud, silt, or other particulates underwater.
